folio_payment_sign_ck.name: folio_payment_sign_ck
folio_payment_sign_ck.value: ("folio_payment"."kind" = 'PAYMENT' AND "folio_payment"."amount_cents" > 0) OR ("folio_payment"."kind" <> 'PAYMENT' AND "folio_payment"."amount_cents" < 0 AND "folio_payment"."related_payment_id" IS NOT NULL)

guest_id_document_last4_ck.name: guest_id_document_last4_ck
guest_id_document_last4_ck.value: "guest"."id_document_last4" IS NULL OR (char_length("guest"."id_document_last4") = 4 AND "guest"."id_document_number" IS NOT NULL)

rate_plan_values_ck.name: rate_plan_values_ck
rate_plan_values_ck.value: "rate_plan"."included_occupancy" >= 1 AND "rate_plan"."extra_adult_cents" >= 0 AND "rate_plan"."extra_child_cents" >= 0 AND ("rate_plan"."min_los" IS NULL OR "rate_plan"."min_los" >= 1)
